task: Available-balance budgeting: monthly income/fixed-expenses settings, per-goal allocation suggestions across active goals, and a multi-goal lump-sum split action
acceptanceCriteria: User can set/edit monthly income and fixed expenses (rent, food, other) via GET/PUT /api/budget
GET /api/budget/available computes income - fixed expenses - sum(active goals' monthly need), converting cross-currency goal needs individually into one budget currency
Deadline-less, overdue-without-suggestion, and completed goals are excluded with a correct human-readable reason (no_deadline/overdue/completed)
When shortfall > 0, a nearest-deadline-first allocation suggestion is returned in server order
A missing FX rate degrades GET /budget/available to rateUnavailable:true (200), but makes POST /entries/split throw 503 rather than write an unconverted amount
POST /api/entries/split creates one SavingsEntry per goal atomically (all-or-nothing), sharing one FX rate fetch across the whole split
Frontend: /budget settings form, dashboard available-balance card (4 states), /split screen; Apply only navigates with prefill, never mutates until the user submits
Every new error is a stable i18n key with matching vi/ja translations; every new endpoint is userId-scoped with cross-user access returning 404
blastRadius: GoalsModule (BudgetModule depends on it one-way; GoalsModule itself unmodified)
SavingsEntriesService's existing single-goal create()/update() paths (freeze() extraction must not change their behavior)
Dashboard page (new card mounted above CurrencyTotals)
i18n key sets for both locales
contracts: GET/PUT /api/budget, GET /api/budget/available, POST /api/entries/split (all new, no existing endpoint's contract changed)
AuthResult/SavingsEntry response shapes unchanged for existing endpoints
